home.eyebrow: Sport Rehabilitator · Made Running Hub, Manchester
headline: Recover properly.
Perform at your best.
home.lede: Injury treatment, sports massage, recovery and performance rehab at Manchester's home of running. We fix the problem, explain why it happened and build you back stronger.
home.servicesLede: Clear prices. Book and pay in under a minute: no phone calls, no back-and-forth.

approach.title: From injury to performance.
approach.lede: Whether you're coming back from injury or chasing a PB, every plan follows the same proven path.

steps.title: Assess
steps.body: A detailed conversation and hands-on assessment to find the real cause, not just where it hurts.

steps.title: Treat
steps.body: Targeted treatment, from soft tissue work to mobility, to ease pain and restore movement.

steps.title: Rebuild
steps.body: A progressive rehab programme to rebuild strength and control, with every step explained.

steps.title: Perform
steps.body: Return-to-sport testing and conditioning so you come back stronger and stay that way.

running.title: Based at Made Running Hub.
running.body: From first 5Ks to marathon PBs, I work with runners every day. I understand mileage, niggles, taper weeks and race-day nerves, and I'll help you stay on the start line.

aboutTeaser.title: I know what it takes to come back, because I've done it.
aboutTeaser.body: A torn meniscus playing rugby taught me how much the right rehab, education and support matter. Now I help others do the same.

finalCta.title: Ready to move better?
finalCta.body: Pick your session, choose a time and you're booked. It takes less than a minute.

services.title: Services
services.lede: Assessment, treatment and recovery for runners, athletes and anyone who wants to move and feel better.

rehab.label: Rehab & assessment
rehab.blurb: Find the cause, treat it properly and get a plan to stay fixed.

recovery.label: Recovery & soft tissue
recovery.blurb: Hands-on and assisted recovery to ease tension and bounce back faster.

performance.label: Performance
performance.blurb: Strength and conditioning that bridges rehab and peak performance.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lede: Simple, transparent prices. You pay securely when you book.
pricing.homeVisitNote: Home visits are available for most services. A travel charge applies depending on distance.
pricing.vouchersNote: Have a gift voucher? Enter the code at checkout.

about.title: Helping you move better, perform better and return with confidence.

homeVisits.title: Home visits
homeVisits.lede: Treatment in the comfort of your own home, ideal if travelling is difficult or you'd simply prefer it.
homeVisits.body: Home visits are available for most services across Manchester. Because travel time varies, each home visit is priced with a personalised quote. Tell me where you are and when suits you, and I'll come back to you with a price and a secure link to confirm and pay.
steps: Send your postcode, the service and times that suit you.
I'll reply with a personalised quote, usually within one working day.
Confirm and pay through a secure link and you're booked.
homeVisits.success: Thanks! Your request is in. I'll reply with a quote shortly.

vouchers.title: Gift vouchers
vouchers.lede: Give the gift of recovery. A sports or relaxing massage e-voucher for the runner, lifter or desk-worker in your life, emailed instantly with a unique code.
how: Choose a voucher and add a personal message.
Pay securely. The e-voucher is emailed straight away.
They redeem the code when booking online.
vouchers.terms: Vouchers are valid for {{expiryMonths}} months from purchase and can be redeemed against any service. Any unused balance stays on the code until it expires.

testimonials.title: What clients say
testimonials.lede: Real feedback from people I've helped get back to doing what they love.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Everything you need to know before your first session.

contact.title: Contact & location
contact.lede: Get in touch or come and see me at Made Running Hub.
contact.success: Thanks, your message has been sent. I'll get back to you soon.

picker.title: Not sure which session to book?
picker.lede: Answer a couple of quick questions and I'll point you in the right direction.

rules.why: An assessment pinpoints what's going on and you'll start treatment and a rehab plan the same day.
Deep tissue sports massage is ideal for sore, overworked muscles after training or a race.
Compression boots flush tired legs while you relax. Choose the extended session after a race.
Dry cupping targets stubborn tension and aches, and pairs well with massage.
The Full Body MOT screens your whole body and gives you a prioritised plan.
Assisted stretching unlocks range you can't reach on your own.
Sports massage releases knots and muscle tension so you move freely.

book.title: Book a session
book.holdNotice: We're holding this time for you
book.redFlagNotice: Thanks for letting me know. Some of your answers mean it's worth getting checked by your GP or calling NHS 111 before or alongside treatment. If you have sudden numbness around the groin, loss of bladder or bowel control, or chest pain, call 999. Your booking can still go ahead and I'll review your answers beforehand.
book.confirmedBody: A confirmation with a calendar invite is on its way to your inbox.
beforeYouCome: Wear comfortable clothing that lets you move easily, and bring shorts if you can.
Free parking is right outside Made Running Hub.
Arrive a couple of minutes early so we can make the most of your time.
